arm.system:
You write modern, idiomatic Luau and follow current Roblox best practices:
- task.wait/task.spawn/task.defer (never the deprecated global wait/spawn), no Instance.new parent argument,
  use CFrame math correctly, prefer attributes over Value objects, RemoteEvents in ReplicatedStorage,
  server logic in ServerScriptService, client logic in StarterPlayerScripts/StarterGui.
- Scripts communicate via ModuleScripts and Remote events; never trust the client on the server.
- UI: build with Frames/UIListLayout/UICorner/UIPadding, scale-based sizing for cross-device support.
- Player-authored text that another player will see goes through TextService:FilterStringAsync
  before it is stored, replicated or shown. Filtering is a platform requirement, not a style choice.
- DataStore calls THROW. pcall is the floor, not the plan: retry a failed read or write a bounded
  number of times with a pause between attempts, and treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
- A value two servers can change at once — currency, inventory, a shared counter — is written with
  UpdateAsync and a transform that reads the CURRENT value. A GetAsync/SetAsync pair silently loses
  the other server's write.
- A failed load is not an empty account. Never write a default over a key whose read failed; skip
  saving that session instead.

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local EMOTE_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://507771019"

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local currentTrack: AnimationTrack? = nil

local function playEmote()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		return
	end

	-- Stop any emote we already started so repeated presses restart cleanly
	if currentTrack then
		currentTrack:Stop(0.1)
		currentTrack = nil
	end

	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = EMOTE_ANIMATION_ID

	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
	track:Play()

	currentTrack = track

	track.Stopped:Connect(function()
		if currentTrack == track then
			currentTrack = nil
		end
		animation:Destroy()
	end)
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then
		return
	end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		playEmote()
	end
end)

-- ServerScriptService/BuyItemServer.lua

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "BuyItem"
remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local ITEMS = {
	Sword = {
		Cost = 100,
		ToolName = "Sword",
	},
}

local function giveItem(player: Player, itemName: string)
	local toolTemplate = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(itemName)
	if not toolTemplate then
		return false
	end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack and not backpack:FindFirstChild(itemName) and not player.Character:FindFirstChild(itemName) then
		toolTemplate:Clone().Parent = backpack
		return true
	end
	return false
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName)
	-- Validate input; never trust the client
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coins or not coins:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	-- Already owns it?
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(item.ToolName))
		or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(item.ToolName)) then
		return
	end

	if coins.Value < item.Cost then
		return
	end

	-- Deduct first, then grant; refund if granting fails
	coins.Value -= item.Cost

	local ok = giveItem(player, item.ToolName)
	if not ok then
		coins.Value += item.Cost
	end
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local POTION_COST = 25
local MAX_PER_PURCHASE = 100

local buyPotion = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyPotion.Name = "BuyPotion"
buyPotion.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getLeaderstat(player: Player, name: string): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) :: IntValue?
end

buyPotion.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, quantity: unknown)
	-- Never trust the client: validate type and range
	if type(quantity) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	quantity = math.floor(quantity)
	if quantity < 1 or quantity > MAX_PER_PURCHASE then
		return
	end

	local coins = getLeaderstat(player, "Coins")
	local potions = getLeaderstat(player, "Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

	local totalCost = quantity * POTION_COST
	if coins.Value < totalCost then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= totalCost
	potions.Value += quantity
end)

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ADMINS = { [1001] = true }

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("TeleportPlayer")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "TeleportPlayer"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function isAdmin(player: Player): boolean
	return ADMINS[player.UserId] == true
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(caller: Player, targetPlayer: Player, position: Vector3)
	if not isAdmin(caller) then
		return -- silently ignore non-admins
	end

	if typeof(targetPlayer) ~= "Instance" or not targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end

	if typeof(position) ~= "Vector3" then
		return
	end

	local character = targetPlayer.Character
	if not character then
		return
	end

	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- Keep them upright at the requested position, slightly above ground level
	local halfHeight = root.Size.Y / 2
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, halfHeight + 1, 0))
end)

-- ServerScriptService/PetRenameServer.lua

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 24
local MIN_NAME_LENGTH = 1
local RATE_LIMIT_SECONDS = 3

local renameEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
renameEvent.Name = "RenamePet"
renameEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local lastRename: {[Player]: number} = {}

local function sanitize(raw: string): string
	raw = raw:gsub("[%z\1-\31\127]", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	return raw
end

local function filterForPlayer(player: Player, text: string): string
	local success, result = pcall(function()
		local filtered = TextService:FilterStringAsync(text, player.UserId)
		return filtered:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if success and result then
		return result
	end
	return ""
end

renameEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, newName: unknown)
	if typeof(newName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if lastRename[player] and now - lastRename[player] < RATE_LIMIT_SECONDS then
		return
	end

	local cleaned = sanitize(newName)
	if #cleaned < MIN_NAME_LENGTH or #cleaned > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return
	end

	local filtered = filterForPlayer(player, cleaned)
	if #filtered == 0 then
		return
	end

	lastRename[player] = now

	local petName = player:FindFirstChild("PetName")
	if not petName then
		petName = Instance.new("StringValue")
		petName.Name = "PetName"
		petName.Parent = player
	end
	petName.Value = filtered
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastRename[player] = nil
end)

local MAX_RETRIES = 3

	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveInventory(player)
	local inventory = player:GetAttribute("Inventory")
	if inventory == nil then
		return
	end

	local key = "Inv_" .. player.UserId
	local saved = false

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(oldValue)
				-- Only overwrite if the stored value differs; keeps other servers' writes intact
				if oldValue == inventory then
					return nil -- no change, abort write
				end
				return inventory
			end)
		end)

		if ok then
			saved = true
			break
		end

		warn(("DataStore save failed for %s (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(player.Name, attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not saved then
		warn(("Inventory for %s was NOT saved."):format(player.Name))
		return
	end

	-- Analytics post (best effort, never blocks or fails the save)
	task.spawn(function()
		for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				HttpService:PostAsync("https://example.com/log", inventory, Enum.HttpContentType.TextPlain)
			end)
			if ok then
				return
			end
			warn(("Analytics post failed (attempt %d/%d): %s"):format(attempt, MAX_RETRIES, tostring(err)))
			if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
				task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveInventory)

-- ServerScriptService/CoinsService.lua
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local KEY_PREFIX = "Player_"
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loaded = {} -- [player] = true if the read succeeded

local function retry(fn)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("[CoinsService] attempt %d/%d failed: %s"):format(attempt, MAX_RETRIES, result))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function getCoinsValue(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	return leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local key = KEY_PREFIX .. player.UserId
	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	if ok then
		if type(data) == "table" and type(data.Coins) == "number" then
			coins.Value = math.floor(data.Coins)
		end
		loaded[player] = true
	else
		-- Load failed: do NOT treat this as a new account. Skip saving this session.
		warn(("[CoinsService] load failed for %s; saving disabled this session"):format(player.Name))
	end
end

local function savePlayer(player)
	if not loaded[player] then
		return -- never overwrite a key whose read failed
	end
	local coins = getCoinsValue(player)
	if not coins then
		return
	end
	local key = KEY_PREFIX .. player.UserId
	local sessionValue = coins.Value

	-- UpdateAsync reads the CURRENT stored value, so concurrent servers can't clobber each other.
	local ok = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
			local data = current
			if type(data) ~= "table" then
				data = {}
			end
			local stored = tonumber(data.Coins) or 0
			-- keep the highest value seen; adjust policy here if needed
			data.Coins = math.max(stored, sessionValue)
			return data
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(("[CoinsService] FAILED to save coins for %s"):format(player.Name))
	end
	return ok
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
	savePlayer(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

-- Shutdown safety: flush every player's data before the server dies.
game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() then
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end
	local remaining = {}
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		remaining[player] = true
	end
	local done = 0
	local total = 0
	for player in pairs(remaining) do
		total += 1
		task.spawn(function()
			savePlayer(player)
			done += 1
		end)
	end
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	while done < total and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function getCoins(player: Player): number?
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			return if result == nil then 0 else result
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return nil -- read never succeeded; treat as failed load
end

local function saveCoins(player: Player, coins: number): boolean
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync reads the CURRENT value so concurrent servers can't be clobbered
			store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function(old)
				return coins
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local loaded = getCoins(player)
	if loaded == nil then
		-- Failed load is NOT an empty account: don't overwrite, don't save this session
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s; saving disabled this session"):format(player.Name))
		coins.Value = 0
		player:SetAttribute("SaveDisabled", true)
		return
	end
	coins.Value = loaded
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("SaveDisabled") then
		return
	end
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if coins then
		saveCoins(player, coins.Value)
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if not player:GetAttribute("SaveDisabled") then
			local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
			local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
			if coins then
				saveCoins(player, coins.Value)
			end
		end
	end
end)
